contract_routes.title: Approval routes
contract_routes.subtitle: Who approves contract requests and contracts, in what order, and when each step applies.
contract_routes.mode_route_help: Every new submission follows the steps below. Ones already in approval finish on the steps they started with.
contract_routes.mode_in_review_help: Your company requires a second person to review workflow changes. The steps apply once a reviewer publishes them.
contract_routes.mode_designer: A workflow from the Workflow designer is in use
contract_routes.mode_designer_help: Approvals follow a workflow designed in the Workflow module. Saving steps here replaces it for new submissions.
contract_routes.mode_simple_help: Until you save steps, a request is decided by one approver (never the requester) and a contract follows the approval steps on the Approvals page.
contract_routes.no_roles: Nobody in this company holds a role yet
contract_routes.footnote: Nobody can approve their own submission. A rejection ends the approval; "may send back" lets that approver return it to the submitter to correct, and it comes back to the same step.
